title: 16-Mode 2D Gaussian Ring Acquisition
intuition: Core Tier-1 multimodal acquisition test: recover all 16 equally weighted 2D Gaussians arranged on a circle (R=3.0, sigma=0.10) with balanced occupancy (mass_tv <= 0.15), high quality (hq >= 0.85), and non-collapsed per-mode covariance.
failure_mode: Mode dropping, inter-mode bridges along chords of the circle, or collapsed per-mode eigenvalues (component_min_eigen_ratio < 0.15) caused by poor Law 1 support geometry or unstable critic forces.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required benchmark (clean live evaluation over 4,096 samples, 24 observations).
